question: The Battle of Buxar was fought between the forces under the command of the British East India Company led by Hector Munro, and the combined armies of ______.

options.text: Mir jafar, Siraj-ud-Daulah and Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II
Mir Qasim, Mughal Emperor Shah Alam-II & Shuja-ud-daulah of Awadh
Mir Jafar, Mughal Emperor Bahadur Shah II, Shuja-ud-Daulah
Siraj-ud-Daulah, Shuja-ud-Daulah, Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mir Qasim, Mughal Emperor Shah Alam & Shuja-ud-daulah of Awadh**__.
